settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: Detailed miniatures of construction crane equipment, finished in bright yellow on branded bases and produced in matched batches. A memorable corporate gift and giveaway for equipment makers, rental firms and project teams.
settings.s1_body: We recreate your crane and lifting equipment as accurate, branded miniatures - finished in your colours and produced in the quantities you need. Ideal as client gifts, event giveaways or reception pieces that put your machines in front of customers in a form they will actually keep.
settings.case_body: Produced as a branded batch for Al Futtaim, these crane miniatures became client gifts and event giveaways - small, on-brand reminders of the machines the company puts on site. About 600 qty of miniature were made for them.
settings.case_quote: A whole batch, all identical and perfectly branded. Our clients loved them.
settings.case_quote_attr: Arun - Sales Manager at Al Futtaim Machinery
settings.prov_p: Cranes are the backbone of every major project. A faithful miniature celebrates that work and keeps your brand in view on desks and shelves.
